exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Where do you buy most of your clothes? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: How often do you buy new clothes for yourself? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: How do you decide which clothes to buy? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Have the kinds of clothes you like changed in recent years? [Why?/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe an interesting discussion you had about how you spend your money. You should say: who you had the discussion with why you discussed this topic what the result of the discussion was and explain why this discussion was interesting for you.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: Why do some parents give their children money to spend each week?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Do you agree that schools should teach children how to manage money?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you think it is a good idea for students to earn money while studying?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Do you think it is true that in today's society money cannot buy happiness?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: What disadvantages are there in a society where the gap between rich and poor is very large?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Do you think richer countries have a responsibility to help poorer countries?
